About this item

  • MORE SPEED – Smart home hub features the new Hue Chip Pro with ultra-fast processing speeds of 1.7 GHz and a quad-core Cortex-A35 CPU for super-fast response times and the ability to run complex algorithms and AI-powered features
  • MORE CAPACITY – Easily migrate all your existing Hue devices to the new Bridge and add even more with built-in support for 150+ lights and 50+ accessories for smart home lighting, plus 8 GB eMMC flash memory to ensure capacity for more features in the future
  • MORE MEMORY – The smart hub is equipped for the future with 8 GB DDR4 SDRAM, providing faster data transfers and increased capacity to store up to 500 personalised scenes and more automations for added convenience
  • MOTION SENSING – With Hue MotionAware you can program your smart lights to switch on automatically when movement is detected; all you need are 3 Hue devices with no separate motion sensors required
  • DATA PROTECTION – Protect your data and privacy with enhanced security controls; the WiFi hub uses the new Zigbee Trust Centre to prevent unauthorised access

From the manufacturer

Hue Motion Aware

Previous page
Next page
Previous page
Next page
Previous page
Next page

  • How to migrate content from my existing Hue Bridge to my new Hue Bridge Pro?

    Once you onboard your Hue Bridge Pro via the Hue app, you’ll be prompted to migrate content from your existing Bridge. Check our video section for a demo on how to migrate your Hue Bridge. You can also do it later via Settings > Bridges

  • Can I migrate multiple Bridges to my Hue Bridge Pro?

    Yes, after onboarding a Hue Bridge Pro, you'll be guided to migrate multiple bridges (if available). Check our support section to know what content will be moved in extra bridges. You can also migrate additional ones via Settings > Bridges

  • What devices will be migrated automatically?

    Hue devices: lights, plugs, switches, sensors, cameras, doorbells, and chimes will migrate automatically. The app will guide you on reconnecting Works with Hue switches or devices that might have had issues migrating

  • What devices will not be migrated or supported?

    Non-Hue, Zigbee 3.0 compatible lights and switches will have their settings migrated but will need to be reconnected following manufacturer's instructions. Non-Zigbee 3.0 or SmartLink devices are not supported by the Hue Bridge Pro.

  • Which 3rd party integrations are supported by the Hue Bridge Pro?

    The Hue Bridge Pro has been designed to meet current standards on software security (e.g. HTTPs). Unfortunately not all third party applications have been updated to support this. We recommend reaching out to these 3rd party apps for support.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings, help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyses reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
Required to use my hue outdoor motion sensor
The Philips Hue Bridge Pro is the heart of a great smart lighting setup. It connects up to 50 Hue lights and accessories reliably, and the improved performance over the older Bridge makes everything feel faster and more stable. Setup is straightforward through the Hue app — it took me less than 5 minutes. Once connected, I can control all my lights from anywhere, create routines, scenes, and automations with ease. It works seamlessly with Alexa, Google Assistant, and Apple HomeKit, and the new Matter support adds excellent future-proofing. I use it for my porch light which is connected via the hue outdoor motion sensor and works great. I especially like the enhanced range and stability; no more dropped connections even when lights are spread across multiple floors. The compact design tucks away neatly behind furniture or in a cabinet. If you’re building or expanding a Philips Hue system, the Bridge Pro is essential and worth the upgrade. Pros: • Fast, stable connection for up to 50 devices • Easy setup and reliable performance • Matter support + full voice assistant compatibility • Compact and future-proof Cons: • None for me — it just works perfectly 5/5 – A must-have for any serious Philips Hue smart home. Highly recommended!

  • ZsiNor
    5 out of 5 stars
    It just works
    Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 12 August 2026
    Style Name: Pro
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Compared to the release of this hub, I'm late to the party which means I've missed many issues other's may have reported.

    Had the previous hub before this but since I got more devices and really wanted to try out MotionAware, I bought this. Read that many were complaining that the migration from the old hub went south. It took an hour to get everything set up as I've unplugged one of my devices earlier and that was pending a firmware upgrade which stops you from starting the migration itself. Had to remove that for now through the app and everything went well afterwards. Even in Home Assistant I had no issues, devices were kept, were moved to a new hub and all worked as previous.

    Now, let's focus on MotionAware. It's great. Really is. Fast, reliable and probably able to replace many presence sensors but there's a catch. In the app even I've removed all actions relating the MotionAware, you have to have a single action entry there even if it's set to do "nothing", it does do "something". Home Assistant is aware of MotionAware and can be used in an automation.

    For those who don't own many Hue devices, the old hub may be enough until Philips discontinues it which might happen due to device limitations and needs in the future. Many would hate that idea but hey, same goes with your phone.

    For Paul Hibbert fans out there: It just works!!

    A really good upgrade compared to the hue bridge V2, very easy and straightforward to set up either via the supplied cable or wireless ( Philips hue app is also required). Offers a lot more features, along with being able to connect/control more devices. Appearance wise it looks virtually the same as V2, with the same kind of foot print.   • Simon Salvin
    4 out of 5 stars
    Great new features! No PoE…
    Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 12 October 2025
    Style Name: Pro
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    The migration function worked well with just a single motion sensor needing reconnection.

    Just be mindful if you are using in a HomeKit environment you will have to add the hub back in to Apple Home and reset any automations featuring your lights.

    The Controller for HomeKit app is a great help for finding the automations that have disappeared and adding extra conditions not found in Apple Home.

    Connecting to Apple Home via Matter now gives the ability to add Hue scenes to Apple Home, that’s a great bonus!

    However, back to Hue, the new Motion aware feature is great allowing you to create simple motion on/off automations with great sensitivity controls. I’m sure over time more features could be added to allow more complex automations. I would like to see a no motion/do this rather than just time based options to create a true occupancy sensor.

    The Wi-Fi option is a nice addition, long overdue, although not required for me.

    At one point I was running two bridges to get all the devices in. I live in a 2 bed apartment so I could see larger houses running out of capacity quickly, however the this new hub triples the device count so hopefully no need for multiple hubs in the future.

    The build quality is solid. I’m sure over time they’ll be deals which bring down the cost.

    It’s powered by USB-C and my only complaint, losing a star, is no PoE.

    3 out of 5 stars
    Be prepared - give your self a few hours
    Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 22 September 2025
    Style Name: Pro
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Put aside a few hours just in case...

    While I had seen online that the migration was fairly seamless - for me, it was a total disaster.

    I followed all of the instructions, there was a single bulb that it said needed a firmware update - I did that - and then went back through the migration - it said it would take 20-30 minutes I think. It said everything could be moved, although it notified me I'd have to setup Apple Homekit again.

    When it finished, it told me it had a issue reconnecting a couple of devices. No problem I thought, how hard can it be to sort out 1 or 2 lights.

    But no - It had failed to reconnect to every-single device - No lights, no switches, no sensors - everything failed and needed manual reconnection. It took 3 hours to reconnect most of the devices.

    So, just be prepared - hopefully it will just work if you need to do this - but incase it doesn't make sure you have the time to sort it all out.

    Great upgrade from the previous bridge
    Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 8 May 2026
    Style Name: Pro
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.

    This is a great upgrade from the previous Hue Bridge. Previously I had two Bridges, they have been running continually for years, one failed and the Pro Bridge came up as a choice when looking to replace. The existing, still running Bridge was able to transfer all of it's lights, sensors and switches across to the Pro in a matter of minutes - no additional setup was required, although I did find a number of devices now had more setup options available that could be changed when ready. Adding the failed Bridges devices was really easy too. Now I only need run one Bridge as the capacity is so much more and I still have space for further devices. If you're moving from an older Bridge you'll notice the speed difference in lights coming on or turning off - if you use voice commands it's almost instant response. I think it's great value for money, and if it lasts as long as the previous Bridge, even more so.

About this Item

  • MORE SPEED – Smart home hub features the new Hue Chip Pro with ultra-fast processing speeds of 1.7 GHz and a quad-core Cortex-A35 CPU for super-fast response times and the ability to run complex algorithms and AI-powered features
  • MORE CAPACITY – Easily migrate all your existing Hue devices to the new Bridge and add even more with built-in support for 150+ lights and 50+ accessories for smart home lighting, plus 8 GB eMMC flash memory to ensure capacity for more features in the future
  • MORE MEMORY – The smart hub is equipped for the future with 8 GB DDR4 SDRAM, providing faster data transfers and increased capacity to store up to 500 personalised scenes and more automations for added convenience
  • MOTION SENSING – With Hue MotionAware you can program your smart lights to switch on automatically when movement is detected; all you need are 3 Hue devices with no separate motion sensors required
  • DATA PROTECTION – Protect your data and privacy with enhanced security controls; the WiFi hub uses the new Zigbee Trust Centre to prevent unauthorised access

Product description

Make your smart home lights even smarter with the new Bridge Pro, now wireless, so that you can place it anywhere. The hub for smart home is packed with upgrades, including the ability to incorporate your lights into your home security by turning them into motion sensors using MotionAware ™ technology. This next-generation Hue smart hub is faster and stronger than ever, powered by an ultra-fast chip capable of running complex algorithms and AI-powered features for more than 150 smart lights and over 50 accessories.
